title: Bolsonaro’s Escape From Brazil Was Aided by Milei Adviser at Argentine Airport
summary: A top adviser to President Javier Milei of Argentina met Flávio Bolsonaro, the defeated Brazilian presidential candidate, at an Argentine airport, three people involved in the operation said.
